lifeContexts: Return after action and new evidence
inquiryOperations: Design an authentic test or artifact
Review outcome and revise the account
selfLenses: Possible best self with stated resources

seedBank.status: Separate reviewed seed library; not counted as completed atlas slots.

notes: This is a coverage and production plan, not a claim that 100,000 questions have been generated.
Territory quotas guide breadth. Reject weak or inapplicable combinations instead of filling a quota with paraphrases.
The 120-hour programme traverses selected pathways; it does not require every atlas question to be spoken or answered.
The existing 300 prompts are a seed and calibration set, separate from generated atlas output.
Generated, checked and answered are independent statuses; checking is not personal endorsement of an answer.
Question generation uses curated design evidence. Exact claims require source verification; a question must not smuggle an unsupported fact into its premise.

delivery.timing: Count actual delivered words and stream minutes; pauses, answers, reflection and actions have separate intervals.
delivery.exampleStatus: Planning arithmetic from an explicit hypothetical average, not a measurement of unwritten questions.

statusSnapshot.reviewNote: Checked counts record summary-only AI editorial reviews of the generated pilot questions. They do not establish primary-source close reading, independent human approval, teaching competence or participant answers.
